1.web: They brought in the ark of God, and set it in the midst of the tent that David had pitched for it: and they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.
1.asv: And they brought in the ark of God, and set it in the midst of the tent that David had pitched for it: and they offered burnt-offerings and peace-offerings before God.

2.web: When David had made an end of offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in Yahweh’s name.
2.asv: And when David had made an end of offering the burnt-offering and the peace-offerings, he blessed the people in the name of Jehovah.

3.web: He dealt to everyone of Israel, both man and woman, to every one a loaf of bread, and a portion of meat, and a cake of raisins.
3.asv: And he dealt to every one of Israel, both man and woman, to every one a loaf of bread, and a portion of flesh, and a cake of raisins.

4.web: He appointed certain of the Levites to minister before Yahweh’s ark, and to celebrate and to thank and praise Yahweh, the God of Israel:
4.asv: And he appointed certain of the Levites to minister before the ark of Jehovah, and to celebrate and to thank and praise Jehovah, the God of Israel:

5.web: Asaph the chief, and second to him Zechariah, Jeiel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Mattithiah, and Eliab, and Benaiah, and Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, with stringed instruments and with harps; and Asaph with cymbals, sounding aloud;
5.asv: Asaph the chief, and second to him Zechariah, Jeiel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Mattithiah, and Eliab, and Benaiah, and Obed-edom, and Jeiel, with psalteries and with harps; and Asaph with cymbals, sounding aloud;

6.web: and Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually, before the ark of the covenant of God.
6.asv: and Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually, before the ark of the covenant of God.

7.web: Then on that day David first ordained to give thanks to Yahweh, by the hand of Asaph and his brothers.
7.asv: Then on that day did David first ordain to give thanks unto Jehovah, by the hand of Asaph and his brethren.

8.web: Oh give thanks to Yahweh. Call on his name. Make his doings known among the peoples.
8.asv: O give thanks unto Jehovah, call upon his name; Make known his doings among the peoples.

9.web: Sing to him. Sing praises to him. Tell of all his marvelous works.
9.asv: Sing unto him, sing praises unto him; Talk ye of all his marvellous works.

10.web: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek Yahweh rejoice.
10.asv: Glory ye in his holy name; Let the heart of them rejoice that seek Jehovah.

11.web: Seek Yahweh and his strength. Seek his face forever more.
11.asv: Seek ye Jehovah and his strength; Seek his face evermore.

12.web: Remember his marvelous works that he has done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,
12.asv: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done, His wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,

13.web: you seed of Israel his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
13.asv: O ye seed of Israel his servant, Ye children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

14.web: He is Yahweh our God. His judgments are in all the earth.
14.asv: He is Jehovah our God; His judgments are in all the earth.

15.web: Remember his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,
15.asv: Remember his covenant for ever, The word which he commanded to a thousand generations,

16.web: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac.
16.asv: The covenantwhich he made with Abraham, And his oath unto Isaac,

17.web: He confirmed the same to Jacob for a statute, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant,
17.asv: And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a statute, To Israel for an everlasting covenant,

18.web: saying, “I will give you the land of Canaan, The lot of your inheritance,”
18.asv: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, The lot of your inheritance;

19.web: when you were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners were in it.
19.asv: When ye were but a few men in number, Yea, very few, and sojourners in it;

20.web: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.
20.asv: And they went about from nation to nation, And from one kingdom to another people.

21.web: He allowed no man to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,
21.asv: He suffered no man to do them wrong; Yea, he reproved kings for their sakes,

22.web: “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”
22.asv: Saying, Touch not mine anointed ones, And do my prophets no harm.

23.web: Sing to Yahweh, all the earth! Display his salvation from day to day.
23.asv: Sing unto Jehovah, all the earth; Show forth his salvation from day to day.

24.web: Declare his glory among the nations, and his marvelous works among all the peoples.
24.asv: Declare his glory among the nations, His marvellous works among all the peoples.

25.web: For great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised. He also is to be feared above all gods.
25.asv: For great is Jehovah, and greatly to be praised: He also is to be feared above all gods.

26.web: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but Yahweh made the heavens.
26.asv: For all the gods of the peoples are idols: But Jehovah made the heavens.

27.web: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and gladness are in his place.
27.asv: Honor and majesty are before him: Strength and gladness are in his place.

28.web: Ascribe to Yahweh, you relatives of the peoples, ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength!
28.asv: Ascribe unto Jehovah, ye kindreds of the peoples, Ascribe unto Jehovah glory and strength;

29.web: Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come before him. Worship Yahweh in holy array.
29.asv: Ascribe unto Jehovah the glory due unto his name: Bring an offering, and come before him; Worship Jehovah in holy array.

30.web: Tremble before him, all the earth. The world also is established that it can’t be moved.
30.asv: Tremble before him, all the earth: The world also is established that it cannot be moved.

31.web: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice! Let them say among the nations, “Yahweh reigns!”
31.asv: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice; And let them say among the nations, Jehovah reigneth.

32.web: Let the sea roar, and its fullness! Let the field exult, and all that is therein!
32.asv: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; Let the field exult, and all that is therein;

33.web: Then the trees of the forest will sing for joy before Yahweh, for he comes to judge the earth.
33.asv: Then shall the trees of the wood sing for joy before Jehovah; For he cometh to judge the earth.

34.web: Oh give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
34.asv: O give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever.

35.web: Say, “Save us, God of our salvation! Gather us together and deliver us from the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise.”
35.asv: And say ye, Save us, O God of our salvation, And gather us together and deliver us from the nations, To give thanks unto thy holy name, And to triumph in thy praise.

36.web: Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting. All the people said, “Amen,” and praised Yahweh.
36.asv: Blessed be Jehovah, the God of Israel, From everlasting even to everlasting. And all the people said, Amen, and praised Jehovah.

37.web: So he left there, before the ark of the covenant of Yahweh, Asaph and his brothers, to minister before the ark continually, as every day’s work required;
37.asv: So he left there, before the ark of the covenant of Jehovah, Asaph and his brethren, to minister before the ark continually, as every day’s work required;

38.web: and Obed-Edom with their brothers, sixty-eight; Obed-Edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be doorkeepers;
38.asv: and Obed-edom with their brethren, threescore and eight; Obed-edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be doorkeepers;

39.web: and Zadok the priest, and his brothers the priests, before Yahweh’s tabernacle in the high place that was at Gibeon,
39.asv: and Zadok the priest, and his brethren the priests, before the tabernacle of Jehovah in the high place that was at Gibeon,

40.web: to offer burnt offerings to Yahweh on the altar of burnt offering continually morning and evening, even according to all that is written in Yahweh’s law, which he commanded to Israel;
40.asv: to offer burnt-offerings unto Jehovah upon the altar of burnt-offering continually morning and evening, even according to all that is written in the law of Jehovah, which he commanded unto Israel;

41.web: and with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest who were chosen, who were mentioned by name, to give thanks to Yahweh, because his loving kindness endures forever;
41.asv: and with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest that were chosen, who were mentioned by name, to give thanks to Jehovah, because his lovingkindness endureth for ever;

42.web: and with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should sound aloud, and with instruments for the songs of God; and the sons of Jeduthun to be at the gate.
42.asv: and with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should sound aloud, and with instruments for the songs of God; and the sons of Jeduthun to be at the gate.

43.web: All the people departed every man to his house: and David returned to bless his house.
43.asv: And all the people departed every man to his house: and David returned to bless his house.
